Mutual indemnities: 16.1 Ono indemnifies Array (p0716-p0718); 16.2 Array indemnifies Ono (p0719-p0721); procedure at p0722-p0725 (notice, defense control, settlement consent). Check whether Array's indemnity covers third-party IP infringement from the licensed compounds and whether our indemnity at 16.1 is too broad; review recall cost allocation in sec-16.6.

Article VIII Section 8.2 Exclusivity of Efforts (p0491) restricts Ono and its Affiliates from Commercializing a 'Competing Product' in the Ono Territory (p0492), with post-termination extension where Array terminates for Ono breach. Read for duration, scope, and acquisition/Change-in-Control carve-outs; appears mutual.

Two threads: exclusivity-of-efforts covenant binding Ono (p0491-p0492, cross-referenced p0174), and supply exclusivity — Array supplying Ono's requirements for Materials (p0495, p0509, p0510) with tech-transfer/second-source path (p0508, p0516). Inbound exclusive licences (p0162, p0164) benefit us; do not flag.
No most-favoured-nation or 'no less favourable terms' language found. Nothing obliges Ono to extend best terms to Array; no redline expected.
No employee non-solicitation or no-hire covenant located; searches returned only governance, FTE-cost and inventorship references. Absence is favourable to us.

Section 13.2 Termination by Ono without Cause (p0628) — convenience right but commencing on a redacted date tied to First Commercial Sale; check notice period and wind-down/cost consequences (p0647, p0652). Also 13.3 breach (p0629) and 13.4 bankruptcy (p0630, p0633); confirm Array has no reciprocal convenience exit.

Assignment clause at p0785 (consent required, carve-out for acquirer of substantially all assets) and affiliate assignment requiring consent at p0786. Section 18.10 Change in Control of Array (p0788); definition at p0028/p0034, referenced at p0322. Ono owns INDs/Marketing Approvals (p0326, p0329) and patient samples/Data (p0361, p0299). Confirm cost allocation/error threshold, and review GxP site-audit rights over Ono/Subcontractor 'Audited Sites' at p0340-p0343.

Section 14.3 Liquidated Damages (p0668) appears to run against Array, i.e. in our favour — do not flag. Confirm direction on full read and that no liquidated damages, penalty or termination fee is payable by Ono elsewhere.

Article XV: mutual Effective-Date reps (p0681), Array IP ownership/exclusive-licensee rep (p0703), mutual disclaimer of implied warranties including merchantability and fitness (p0711). Product quality/GMP conformance warranties likely sit in the clinical/commercial supply and quality agreements (p0500-p0501, p0509-p0510). Read sec-p0680 in full for any product warranty and remedy.

No insurance covenant found; only 'insurance' hits are freight and health-insurance references inside the Net Sales definition (p0101, p0102). Treat as missing and consider requesting product liability insurance/self-insurance support for Array's indemnity in sec-p0715.

No express minimum purchase, take-or-pay or shortfall payment located. Article IX contemplates clinical and commercial supply agreements containing forecasting and ordering procedures (p0500-p0501, p0509-p0510), the likely future home of binding-forecast exposure. Confirm no volume commitment in the body of the Agreement.

Article XIV wind-down regime: Wind-down Period and sell-off (p0652-p0654), Clinical Study transition (p0646-p0647), assignment of Regulatory Filings/Marketing Approvals (p0656, p0667), continued commercialization (p0660), Improvement licences to Array (p0661), return/destruction of materials (p0662), domain and Sublicense transfer (p0665-p0666), survival (p0673). Regime runs largely in Array's favour; check reciprocal data return/assistance to Ono and transition cost allocation (p0647).
